text.value: A MAHJONG COMMUNITY BRIDGING GENERATIONS AND CULTURES, ONE HAND AT A TIME.

text.label: Text
text.value: THREE SUITS, THREE HONORS. EVERY GAME OF MAHJONG IS BUILT FROM THESE 144 TILES. HERE IS WHERE BEGINNERS BEGIN.

text.label: Text
text.value: 中 · 發 · 白 — The Dragons

text.label: Text
text.value: Red, Green & White honors. Plus the four Winds — East, South, West, North (東南西北).

content.label: Content
content.value: The clatter of tiles is a language everyone can learn — no matter your age, your accent, or where you call home.

content.label: Content
content.value: What started as four friends around a    folding table in a Milwaukee living room has grown into a community of over two hundred players. Grandmothers teach college students. Newcomers learn from lifelong masters.

content.label: Content
content.value: Every Thursday the tiles come out, the tea is poured, and for a few hours the generational and cultural gaps that divide us simply dissolve into the rhythm of the game.

text.label: Text
text.value: NEW TO THE TABLE? A COMPLETE HAND IS FOUR SETS AND ONE PAIR. HERE IS THE SHAPE OF EVERY GAME.

text.label: Text
text.value: Shuffle all 144 tiles face down and stack them into four walls — the great fortress every hand is drawn from.

text.label: Text
text.value: On your turn, draw one tile and discard one. Read the table, watch what others release, and shape your hand.

text.label: Text
text.value: Collect runs and triplets of the same tile. Three claimed sets and you can almost taste the win.

text.label: Text
text.value: Four sets plus a matching pair completes your hand. Reveal your tiles and declare it.

text.label: Text
text.value: Learned at her grandmother's table in Kowloon, Emily now carries that heritage to every beginner who sits down across from her.

text.label: Text
text.value: A veteran of international circuits, David breaks down advanced scoring into something anyone can pick up in an evening.

text.label: Text
text.value: "A second family, found four tiles at a time."

text.label: Text
text.value: WHETHER IT'S YOUR FIRST HAND OR YOUR THOUSANDTH, THERE'S A SEAT WAITING FOR YOU.

text.label: Text
text.value: A community bridging generations and cultures, one hand at a time.
